examples.prompt: Create a blog post about AI.
issues: No word count or format specified

examples.prompt: Write a detailed technical blog post about machine learning algorithms for software engineers. Include explanations of supervised vs unsupervised learning, provide code examples in Python, and aim for 2000-2500 words. Target audience: mid-level engineers. Use a professional but conversational tone.
Create a social media post.

Write a LinkedIn post announcing our company's new machine learning product. Keep it under 300 characters, include a call-to-action for webinar signup, use professional but enthusiastic tone, and add 3-5 relevant hashtags. Target audience: CTOs and technical leaders.
Create newsletter content.

Compose a weekly tech newsletter for data scientists. Include 4 sections: (1) industry news, (2) tool/library spotlight, (3) research paper summary, (4) community event highlight. Keep each section 100-150 words. Use a conversational, accessible tone. Assume subscribers have 3-5 years data science experience.
Write code.
issues: No problem or use case defined

examples.prompt: Create a Python function that validates email addresses.

Write a Python function named 'validate_email' that accepts an email string and returns True if valid, False otherwise. Use RFC 5322 standard for validation. Include error handling for None/empty inputs. Add docstring with examples. Handle edge cases: multiple @, spaces, non-ASCII chars. Return tuple (is_valid: bool, message: str) for detailed feedback.

Build a REST API endpoint for user authentication using FastAPI. Support login with email/password and JWT token generation. Include password hashing (bcrypt), token expiration (15 min access, 7 day refresh), CORS configuration for frontend at localhost:3000, rate limiting (5 attempts/minute), and comprehensive error responses (401, 403, 429 status codes). Return token in response with user metadata.
Research AI.
issues: No required sources or depth level

examples.prompt: Research recent advances in natural language processing from 2024-2025. Find 5-7 key breakthroughs, summarize each in 200-300 words, include publication links. Focus on transformer models, multimodal learning, and efficient LLMs. Target: technical overview for ML engineers.
Find information about quantum computing.
Analyze blockchain.

Conduct a comprehensive analysis of the impact of AI regulation on tech startups in EU, US, and Asia (2024-2026). Compare regulatory frameworks across regions, identify key compliance costs, analyze market consolidation trends, and project 5-year implications for innovation. Provide 4 detailed case studies (industry-specific: fintech, healthcare, autonomous vehicles, retail). Include risk-benefit analysis and strategic recommendations for startups.
Plan a project.

Create a 12-week project plan for building a Python data pipeline. Team: 2 engineers, 1 data scientist. Goals: process 1TB daily data, 99.9% uptime. Include: phases (design week 1, development weeks 2-8, testing weeks 9-10, deployment weeks 11-12), dependencies, milestones, risk mitigation. Deliverables per phase. Resource allocation per role.
Brainstorm ideas.

Ideate 10-15 innovative SaaS product ideas targeting SMB manufacturing businesses (50-500 employees) in the US. Focus on pain points: supply chain visibility, inventory management, worker safety. Budget per idea: $50K-$200K MVP. Include market size estimate, competitive differentiation, and revenue model for each. Target: technical feasibility for small team (3-4 people).
Summarize this text.

Summarize the following research paper in 300-400 words. Include: main hypothesis, methodology, key findings, limitations, and practical implications. Use bullet points for findings. Target: technical but accessible to non-experts. Paper: [INSERT PAPER].
Explain machine learning.
issues: No specific aspect to focus on

examples.prompt: Explain how transformer neural networks work to a software engineer unfamiliar with ML. Use clear analogies related to software architecture. Cover: attention mechanism, self-attention, multi-head attention, transformer block, encoder-decoder structure. Include 2-3 code pseudocode examples showing tensor operations. Assume familiarity with Python but not math. Keep explanation under 2000 words.
Optimize code.

Optimize this Python database query function. Current: processes 1M records in 45 seconds. Target: <15 seconds. Constraints: read-only database access, max memory 2GB. Provide: optimized code, explanation of improvements, benchmark comparison (before/after), estimated throughput gain. Database: PostgreSQL with 10 million records.
Write a product description for an online course platform.

Write a 150-200 word product description for 'Advanced React Patterns' course. Target: intermediate React developers (1-2 years experience) seeking architecture skills. Highlight: real-world patterns, performance optimization, state management strategies. Include benefits: 30% faster development, better code reuse, interview prep. Use engaging but professional tone. Add 1-2 social proof elements (student success rates, testimonials).
Create a function for data filtering.

Write TypeScript React component for multi-select dropdown with async data loading. Features: (1) search/filter 1000+ items by label, (2) load items on demand via API call, (3) debounce search (300ms), (4) show loading indicator, (5) handle API errors gracefully, (6) keyboard navigation (arrow keys, enter, escape), (7) accessibility (ARIA labels), (8) virtual scrolling for performance. Return selected array of {id, label} objects. Include PropTypes/TypeScript interfaces.
Look up market trends in cloud computing.
issues: No specific segments defined (serverless, containers, etc.)

examples.prompt: Research cloud computing market trends 2023-2026 across 3 regions: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific. Cover: market size growth %, key players, technology adoption rates (Kubernetes, serverless, multi-cloud), pricing trends. Provide data from Gartner, IDC, or analyst reports. Format: 3-4 page report with charts, 10-15 key insights, 3 strategic implications for enterprise buyers.
Analyze competitor landscape.

Competitive analysis: B2B project management SaaS tools (US market, 2024). Compare: Asana, Monday.com, Jira, ClickUp, Notion. Dimensions: pricing models, feature comparison matrix, target market segment, customer reviews (G2 scores), technology stack, integrations, strengths/weaknesses. Output: 20-page report with charts, ranking matrix (features vs. price vs. usability), recommendation framework for different buyer personas.
Organize a hackathon.

Plan a 48-hour virtual hackathon for 500 participants. Goal: build prototypes for supply chain optimization. Timeline: 8-9 Oct 2025 (Fri 6pm - Sun 6pm EST). Budget: $25K. Include: sponsorships recruitment, prize pool ($8K), platform setup (GitHub, Discord, Dev.to), participant tiers (beginner/intermediate/advanced), judging criteria (innovation 40%, implementation 30%, pitch 20%, impact 10%), post-event activities. Deliverables: registration page, rules, team formation process, technical setup guide.
Generate business ideas for a sustainable tech startup.

Generate 8-10 B2B SaaS ideas for sustainable energy sector targeting utilities (200+ MWh/year). Focus: renewable energy management, grid optimization, carbon tracking. Budget per MVP: $100K-$300K. Team size: 4-6 technical people. For each idea include: problem statement, target buyer persona, value prop, revenue model (monthly/per-unit), 5-year market size, competitive landscape (2-3 existing players), go-to-market approach. Prioritize high-margin ideas with <12-month payback.
Create an executive summary.

Write a 1-page executive summary of a Q3 2025 product launch report. Audience: C-suite (CEO, CFO, VP Product). Include: launch impact (revenue, user acquisition), market response (NPS, reviews), technical performance (uptime, latency), competitive wins/losses, top 3 customer feedback points, budget variance, top 3 action items for Q4. Use clear metrics, avoid jargon. Format: sections with bolded headers, bullet points for metrics.
Explain cryptocurrency.
issues: Scope too broad (blockchain, mining, DeFi, NFTs?)

examples.prompt: Explain blockchain technology to a non-technical business executive (CFO). Focus on: (1) how transactions are verified and secured, (2) difference between blockchain and traditional databases, (3) real business use cases (supply chain, payments, identity), (4) security/scalability tradeoffs, (5) regulatory concerns. Use business analogies (ledger, notary, record keeping). Length: 1500-2000 words. Include 3 real-world examples.
Make this system faster.

Optimize a Node.js microservice handling 10K requests/sec. Current: p95 latency 500ms, CPU 80%, memory 4GB. Target: p95 <100ms, CPU <50%, max memory 2GB. Constraints: no code rewrites, use caching/load-balancing, keep Redis <100ms latency. Provide: architectural changes (load balancing strategy, caching layers, database indexing), configuration tuning (node cluster, connection pools), monitoring strategy, rollout plan. Benchmark: before/after metrics.
Write a press release about a company milestone.

Write a 300-word press release announcing TechCorp's Series B funding ($50M). Include: mission statement, funding purpose (expansion, R&D, hiring), investor quotes (2), founder quote (1), product/market traction metrics. Format: headline, subheading, 3 body paragraphs, About section, media contact. Tone: professional, industry-focused, suitable for TechCrunch/VentureBeat. Include: funding lead (Sequoia Capital), investor backgrounds, company growth stats (YoY).
Build an API.

Build a GraphQL API for a photo-sharing app using Apollo Server. Schema: User (id, username, email, followers), Photo (id, imageUrl, caption, likes, createdAt, author: User), Comment (id, text, author: User, photo: Photo). Queries: getUser(id), searchPhotos(query), getPhototoFeed(limit, offset). Mutations: createPhoto, likePhoto, addComment, deleteComment. Subscriptions: onPhotoLiked. Auth: JWT bearer token in header. Pagination: cursor-based. Error handling: custom error codes. Rate limiting: 100 req/min per user. Deploy: Docker on AWS.
Find info on AI job market.
issues: Job categories unclear (ML engineer, data scientist, researcher?)

examples.prompt: Research AI job market trends US/EU/Asia (2024-2026). Find: salary ranges by role (ML engineer, data scientist, prompt engineer, AI product manager), experience level, geographic variations. Include: top hiring companies (50+), skill demand ranking, education background analysis, remote work percentage, career progression paths, certifications value. Data sources: LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Indeed, PayScale. Output: 10-page report with charts, heatmaps, 15 key insights, talent acquisition recommendations.
Analyze trends.

Analyze fintech adoption trends in emerging markets (India, Brazil, Nigeria, Philippines) 2022-2026. Cover: payment apps growth, digital wallet penetration, peer-to-peer lending, cryptocurrency adoption, regulatory environment per country, competitive players per market. Data sources: industry reports, government filings, company disclosures. Output: 30-page strategic report, market sizing per country, growth projections 2026-2030, risk analysis (regulatory, security), strategic recommendations for market entry, M&A targets, partnerships.
Create a roadmap.

Create a 24-month product roadmap for an AI-powered customer service platform. Phases: Phase 1 (mo 1-6, MVP): basic chatbot, ticket routing. Phase 2 (mo 7-12, Traction): sentiment analysis, agent collaboration, integrations (Zendesk, Slack). Phase 3 (mo 13-18, Scale): predictive routing, knowledge base automation, multilingual support. Phase 4 (mo 19-24, Expansion): custom model fine-tuning, white-label offering. Each phase: features, success metrics, resource needs, dependencies, risks, go-to-market activities. Include quarterly milestones.
Come up with startup ideas.

Generate 12-15 AI/ML startup ideas for enterprise data privacy. Target: compliance officers at Fortune 1000 companies managing GDPR/CCPA. Pain points: data governance, PII discovery, compliance auditing, incident response. Budget: $150K-$500K MVP. Team: 3-5 technical co-founders, optional business co-founder. For each idea: problem statement, market size, revenue model, competitive positioning, technical moat, go-to-market strategy (sales/channels), 3-year financial projections, risk assessment. Rank top 3 by market opportunity + technical feasibility.
Summarize a meeting.

Summarize a 90-minute product strategy meeting attended by: CEO, VP Product, Head of Engineering, 2 leads. Inputs: meeting transcript, 15 slides. Output: 2-page summary including: decisions made (3-4 with reasoning), action items (with owner, deadline), blockers identified, resource needs, follow-up meetings scheduled. Format: sections with headers (Decisions, Action Items, Blockers, Next Steps), bullet points, distribute to 25 stakeholders via email.
Explain DevOps.

Explain DevOps practices to a team of backend developers transitioning from waterfall to agile. Audience: 2-5 yrs experience, familiar with Git/Linux, new to CI/CD. Cover: CI/CD pipeline concepts, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes basics), monitoring/observability, deployment strategies (blue-green, canary), tools landscape (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions). Length: 3000 words. Include 5 practical code examples (YAML configs, Dockerfile snippets). Real-world benefits: faster releases, reduced errors, better collaboration.
Reduce latency.

Optimize frontend React app. Current: First Contentful Paint (FCP) 3.2s, Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) 5.1s, Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) 0.15, Time to Interactive (TTI) 6.2s on 4G slow mobile (Lighthouse score: 42). Target: Lighthouse 75+, LCP <2.5s, FCP <1.5s, CLS <0.1. Constraints: no major feature changes, support IE11. Approach: code splitting, lazy loading, image optimization (WebP, responsive), bundle size reduction, caching strategy, CDN setup. Deliverables: optimized code, Lighthouse before/after, performance report.
